text.content:
Three nights in 2067 that made the Mox.

When: 2067
Where: Kabuki and across the city
Who was involved: Sex workers, sexual minorities and their friends; the Tyger Claws; kids on skates who became the G4
What it changed: The Mox were born at Lizzie's Bar; Kabuki's Claw dollhouses closed or started paying the Mox

Tyger Claws killed bar owner Lizzie Borden, and for three nights sex workers and their friends burned Claw businesses across the city. Kids on skates carried messages between the crews, called out where the Claws were moving, and painted Lizzie's face over every Claw lantern in Kabuki. Danger Gal detective Minako Arasaka proved who killed her. Lyle Thompson filmed it; Network 54 ran four seconds. Lizzie's Night marks it every year.

Night City 2070 (The Unification Era), ch.01, 04, 08
